name: j2c
description: Translate Java source code to C++ using the J2C converter.

j2c.sourcePaths.description: Java source roots relative to the workspace folder. Defaults to java.project.sourcePaths, then conventional src folders.

j2c.classPath.description: Dependency jars or class directories, absolute or relative to the workspace folder.

j2c.cliJar.description: Optional path to a J2C CLI jar. The packaged extension includes one by default.

j2c.javaExecutable.description: Java 11 or newer executable used to run the bundled CLI.

j2c.sealedTypes.description: How to handle Java sealed and non-sealed types. Advisory emits C++ inheritance and informational permits comments; reject stops translation.

j2c.mcp.enabled.description: Offer J2C's check, translate, fix, build, explain and capabilities tools to AI agents (such as Copilot agent mode) as an MCP server for each workspace folder. Requires a VS Code version with MCP support.

j2c.tests.description: Check JUnit 4 and 5 tests and generate GoogleTest wrappers that run them (`make test` in the output folder). Requires the JUnit JARs in j2c.classPath, unless the workspace is a Maven or Gradle project (see j2c.project).

j2c.mocks.markdownDescription: Generate a gMock class for each translated Java interface (`mock/<package>/Mock<Interface>.hpp`), for C++ tests you write by hand (`make tests USER_TEST_SRCS=test/my_test.cpp` in the output folder). Abstract methods are mocked; default methods keep their Java bodies. Needs gMock (`libgmock-dev`) to build the tests.

j2c.runtime.markdownDescription: The Java class library translated programs use. `bundled` (the default) translates against the J2C runtime shipped with the extension (`java.lang`, the collections, streams, `String.format`, regular expressions, text input and files), so programs run without writing C++; JDK classes it does not provide are compile errors, listed by **J2C: Check Translatability**. `none` translates against the JDK instead, with every JDK class a generated stub that fails at run time (the CLI's default). Anything else is the path of a runtime directory, relative to the workspace folder.

j2c.lineDirectives.description: Add #line directives to the generated C++, so compiler errors (J2C: Build Translated C++) and debuggers such as gdb refer to Java files and lines.

j2c.build.make.description: The make program J2C: Build Translated C++ runs. Defaults to make (or J2C_MAKE).

j2c.build.wsl.description: Where J2C: Build Translated C++ runs make on Windows: auto uses WSL when make is not on the PATH.

j2c.build.wslDistribution.description: The WSL distribution to build in (with GNU make and a C++20 compiler). Defaults to WSL's default distribution (or J2C_WSL_DISTRO).

enumDescriptions: Detect a Maven or Gradle build (pom.xml, build.gradle, settings.gradle) in the workspace folder or the selected folder, and use its source roots, test roots and dependency class path. The class path is resolved by running the project's wrapper or mvn/gradle, and cached.
Never detect a build; use j2c.sourcePaths and j2c.classPath only.
j2c.project.description: Project auto-setup for Maven and Gradle projects. Also applies to the MCP server's tools.
